title: Rehoboam's Reign in Judah
description: Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, became king in Judah and reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem. The people did what was evil in the Lord's sight; they built high places for sacrifices and worshiped idols. In his fifth year as king, Shishak, king of Egypt, marched up against Jerusalem and took away the treasures from the house of the Lord and the royal palace, including the gold shields that Solomon had made. Rehoboam replaced them with bronze shields. There was constant war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.
